sampling: One uniform reservoir state per fresh normal baselineMCTS640 game, before1536/death. Separate sampling RNG. No selecting on disagreement, score gap, failure or outcome. Equal weight per source game; not V11 rank-stratified distribution.
teacher: same full4ply expectimax teacher asV11; all chance outcomes; frozen leaves; assert completed4
comparator: same original MCTS with640 fixed simulations and depth8; public state only; deterministic search seed as during collection
intervention: Force teacher or baseline first action, then identical baselineMCTS640 continuation to1536/death. This estimates one-step action improvement under that continuation, not whole-game teacher strength.
randomization: Matched32 rollout seeds per disagreement; shuffle remaining hidden deck consistent with public counts, resample current bonus value from public preview. SearchRNG separate. Diverged actions need not imply identical later exogenous events.
agreement: Identical chosen actions imply exactly zero treatment effect with matched deterministic continuation; do not spend rollout budget on duplicates.
statistics: Primary mean success difference across ALL256 states (agreement effects exactly0); paired t95%CI clustered by source state, conditional on fixed original policy. Also report disagreement-only mean and state-cluster CI,32 repetitions not treated as independent boards. Score and rank exploratory.
stopping: Fixed256 source games and32 replicates for every disagreement. No early stopping from results.
scope: Teacher quality audit only; no model training or site changes; no6144 evaluation.
